description: This Dart file defines the SearchScreen widget for a Flutter mobile application. It provides a user interface with a search bar and a list of recipe cards, leveraging Provider for state management of recipe data.

classes.name: SearchScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays a searchable list of recipes with a search bar and recipe cards.
